Bill.BriefDescription: Planning for and funding the state route number 9/state route number 204 intersection project.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the state route number 9/state route number 204intersection project; adding a new section to chapter 47.01 RCW;creating a new section; and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The intent of this act is to identify andfund a project of significance in the Snohomish region.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall develop a project summary and subsequentlybegin the environmental planning process as required under chapter43.21C RCW, or the national environmental policy act if applicable, forthe state route number 9/state route number 204 intersection project.In conjunction with the environmental planning process, the departmentshall prepare a final design for the project.

The sum of five million dollars, or as muchthereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the biennium ending p. 1 SB 6842June 30, 2011, from the motor vehicle account to the department oftransportation for the purposes of section 2 of this act.
